assessment.minimum_justified_conclusion: A 900-second cumulative native limit has no adequate measured composite margin. No exact minimum safe native limit is established by two partial runs.
assessment.proposed_operation_formula: 6 * 600 response seconds + 1500 cumulative native seconds + 300 preparation/unclassified overhead seconds
assessment.purpose: Finite spending ceiling with explicit measured-basis headroom, not an ETA or successful-completion guarantee.

planning_proxy.formula: COMPLETION_V03 total native counter + TASKSTORE_SEAM_V02 nonnested native phase sum + closed TASKSTORE_REMAINDER_V01 full parent wall time

temporal_scope.limitation: All positive qualified consumers occur before the unrelated cold round. In validate_strategy_history, _current(controller) runs before binding expiry and history eligibility; DynamicDocumentController.current checks changed source identity/content before policy expiry. Therefore, after an actual source revision, the owner stale-binding branch can truthfully refuse changed source even if the prior history expired during the second round. This does not renew TTL, reopen expired history, or promise a positive historical consumer after that round. The operation deadline must still be current.
temporal_scope.v01_caveat_corrected: The prior memo must not be read as requiring the whole qualified episode to remain eligible through all three unrelated responses. Only its earlier positive consumers need current eligibility; the later revised-source branch is a negative current-source observation.
